bioParagraphs: I'm a full-stack developer who ended up specializing in the harder half of the stack: backend systems and AI infrastructure. I like problems where the interesting part isn't the UI — it's what happens after the request leaves the browser.

At EY, I helped build an EPFO WhatsApp engagement platform supporting 1M+ active campaign users — the kind of scale where every shortcut you take in the backend eventually finds you. That's where I learned to care about reliability, not just features.

More recently, at Mednex, I helped build an autonomous GTM AI platform now running campaigns for 50+ B2B clients across thousands of leads — agentic orchestration, RAG, and list-building pipelines, not just a thin LLM wrapper.
I design around SOLID principles and layered boundaries — Clean and Hexagonal Architecture — because six months from now, someone (often me) has to change this code without fear.

experiences.description: Contributed to a production AI platform focused on turning complex AI workflows into reliable, composable backend systems.
bullets: Worked alongside the core engineering team on agent orchestration, RAG pipelines, asynchronous workflows, and external data integrations.
Contributed to architectural decisions around workflow state, service boundaries, failure handling, background processing, and reliable execution of multi-step AI tasks.
Worked with LangGraph and LangChain to structure multi-step AI workflows beyond simple prompt-response interactions.

experiences.role: Backend Engineer · EPFO WhatsApp Engagement Platform
experiences.description: Contributed to backend systems for an EPFO WhatsApp engagement platform serving 1M+ active campaign users.
bullets: Built and optimized webhook-driven WhatsApp workflows with idempotent processing, retry-safe execution, and async event handling.
Worked with Redis Streams and RabbitMQ to process high-volume campaign events asynchronously and prevent downstream bottlenecks.
Contributed to independently scalable backend services and reliable event-processing workflows for production messaging.

experiences.description: Started my professional development journey building full-stack applications and backend services, while learning how production software is structured beyond individual features.
bullets: Developed REST APIs for freight-forwarding automation, including quotation generation and automated email workflows.
Built backend services for an AI-powered JEE DPP generator, working with PostgreSQL and Prisma to turn application logic into reliable data-driven workflows.
Worked across the frontend and backend, building a stronger understanding of API design, database modeling, authentication, and end-to-end product development.

projects.title: ToolTap
projects.description: A backend-first AI agent that turns WhatsApp into a full tool-calling interface. Async webhook processing, tool-calling loops, and graceful failure when the LLM or a tool times out mid-conversation.

projects.title: WarmTalk
projects.description: A full-stack mental health platform with Next.js, Node.js, and PostgreSQL. Real-time secure messaging (Socket.io), inclusive therapist matching, and integrated video consultations.
